patches.name: class name of BraceBlockContext
patches.reason: getComment compares this.constructor.name with "BraceBlockContext". In the build that the plugin ships the class has the name "is", so the comparison is false for every context. The patch writes that result.

patches.name: reset of the width cache
patches.reason: The module keeps measured widths for the life of the page, and mmdc renders one diagram in a page. resetCache empties the module, so that a runtime that renders a second diagram starts as a new page does.

patches.name: two-stage parse
patches.reason: The parser first runs with the prediction mode SLL. ANTLR guarantees that an SLL parse that reports no syntax error returns the parse tree of the default mode LL. When the SLL parse reports a syntax error, the text is parsed again in the default mode, as upstream does. The grammar needs full-context prediction for most statements, which the default mode computes again for every statement and SLL keeps in its DFA.
